title: Are Aligned Large Language Models Still Misaligned?
reasoning: The Mis-Align Bench introduced in the paper evaluates and benchmarks dimensions including 'Value' and 'Cultural' domains. These taxonomies specifically include and measure aspects of faith (e.g., 'Devoutness', 'Spiritual Life Focus') and ethics/morals (e.g., 'Honesty', 'Social Justice', 'Forgiveness').
